task.title: How to subtract numbers
task.shortdesc: Here you will find instructions about using the subtraction feature of JPS calculator

prereq.p: To sucessfully subtract numbers, you must know what is subtraction

result.p: The results from subtractions are displayed

example.p: You want to subtract 2 from 3 . The equation will look like 3-2=1. You enter 3 , press - , enter 2, press equlas
